protocol.question: Can a reusable exact budget frontier and independently checked mechanism certificate support fresh budget/value queries without repeatedly constructing the frontier?
protocol.scientific_scope: Known-method, synthetic software demonstration. No live frontier-model experiment, novel economic theorem, network authentication, actual procurement, sale or payment.
protocol.objective: maximize expected buyer value minus supplier payments within deterministic all-or-none posted-price bundle mechanisms, subject to an ex-post hard budget and no-offer option
assumptions: one indivisible required component per supplier

reuse_confirmation.cold_counterfactual: every equally capable recipient uses the same exact DP and full certificate checker at its budget
reuse_confirmation.shared_counterfactual: creator compiles/checks full frontier; each recipient imports and independently revalidates it, then queries; report this conservative import cost separately from trusted-attestation scenarios

acceptance: all 48 small cases match exact exhaustive optimal objective
all 48 emitted protocols pass exhaustive finite DSIC/IR/budget/bundle checks
all five large Bellman certificates pass
protocol.transfer_interpretation: An artifact can replace repeated construction only when its validated input domain is reusable. Recipient intelligence and known DP theory are unchanged. Each receiving agent's full mathematical revalidation is charged; a trusted-attestation reduction is a separate simulated assumption, not this executed witness.
